'''Let's Use Fighting Type Pokémon!!''' (Japanese: '''かくとうポケモンを使いこなせ!!''' ''<!--Needs re-translation-->Use Fighting Pokémon!!'') is the ninth chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
{{GnB|Gold}} and [[Whitney]] arrive in [[Goldenrod City]]. After showing Gold some landmarks like the [[Goldenrod Radio Tower|Radio Tower]], Whitney takes him to the [[Pokémon Day Care]]. At they Day Care, Whitney introduces Gold to the [[Day-Care Couple]], who invite him to take place in a tournament organized by the Day-Care Center. All Pokémon used in the tournament are currently being raised at the Day-Care Center and are used with the permission of the original Trainers. The tournament is being DJed by [[DJ Mary|Kurumi]].

Gold chooses three {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon, as he also wants to use them against Whitney's {{type|Normal}} Pokémon. He chooses {{p|Hitmonlee}}, {{p|Hitmonchan}} and {{p|Hitmontop}}. Using these three Pokémon, Gold battles his way up through the tournament until he reaches the final battle against {{GnB|Black}}.

Black mocks Gold before the battle and reminds him that his Fighting-type Pokémon will be weak against his {{type|Psychic}} {{p|Alakazam}}. Gold decides to fight anyways, sure that his Pokémon will overcome their disadvantage. Black's Alakazam and {{p|Sneasel}} defeat Hitmonlee, and Black says that if Gold announces he will stop being a Trainer, he will stop his Pokémon from attacking Gold's. Gold's Pokémon choose to fight anyways, and the crowd, much to Black's surprise, are cheering for Gold. 

Hitmonchan uses itself as a shield to block Alakazam's {{m|Psychic}} attack from hitting Hitmontop. When Hitmontop got close enough, it used {{m|Triple Kick}}, aiming to hit both Alakazam and Sneasel. Instead, however, Sneasel pushes {{p|Quilava}} in the way, which takes the full force of Hitmontop's attack. Sneasel attacks Hitmontop, winning the battle.

The crowd is outraged at Black's unfair tactics, but Black is indifferent, turning and leaving. The Day-Care Man tells Gold that he is considered the true winner because he fought fairly, and he is awarded a {{p|Tyrogue}}. Gold vows to defeat Black one day.

==Major events==
* {{GnB|Gold}} and [[Whitney]] arrive in [[Goldenrod City]].
* Gold competes in a tournament organized by the [[Pokémon Day Care]].
* {{GnB|Black}} defeats Gold, but Gold is awarded the prize due to Black's unfair tactics.
* Gold receives a {{p|Tyrogue}}.
